messages:
From: Priya Shah <pshah@origamilabs.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot economics — quick ask

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Origami Labs is excited to move to a short POC focused on clinical note summarization (mixed long/short contexts). Before we lock dates, two quick economics questions so I can align procurement and our headcount:

- Can Redwood provide a short-term pilot package that includes a small commit in exchange for launch incentives (free credits + per-token discounts after commit)?
- What do you typically do for per-token pricing tiers for hosted API usage during pilots (we expect ~10M tokens over 30 days peak, heavier on generations)?

We have a procurement window through the end of November; if we can align on a simple structure (credits + a 3-month ramp), we can sign the pilot SOW quickly.

Thanks — would love a one-page term sketch to share internally.

Best,
Priya
Head of Product, Origami Labs

Attachment: product_requirements.docx (referenced)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@origamilabs.com>
Cc: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@origamilabs.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot economics — quick ask

Hi Priya — great to hear and glad the demo landed. Below is a concise pilot sketch we use for customers in your profile. I’ll send a one-page term sheet as a follow-up attachment (and copy our pricing lead on the detailed numbers).

Pilot sketch (30–45 days):
- Trial credits: 75k USD in hosted API credits applied up front.
- Minimum commit: 25k USD committed spend (applied toward credits during pilot).
- Per-token baseline rate during pilot (post-credits): $0.0008 / token for generations, $0.0004 / token for embeddings.
- Commit ramp: if Origami converts to a 3-month staged commit of $150k, you get a standing 12% volume discount on per-token rates and 30k USD additional launch credit.
- Overages: standard overage rates apply if usage exceeds committed slab.

Operational notes:
- We can provide model variant fallbacks to control cost if you need strict spend caps.
- SLA for hosted pilot is 99.5% uptime; dedicated routing can be discussed for production.

I’ve attached a short term sheet and credit schedule. If this looks directionally right I’ll loop Marcus and Marissa to finalize numbers for your procurement team.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Direct: (415) 555-0189

Attachments: Origami_Pilot_Termsheet.pdf, Pilot_Credit_Schedule.xlsx

- Marissa: confirm whether we can authorize an additional $15k launch credit at renewal if they commit to $150k over 3 months.
- Karthik: any compliance notes (VPC/on-prem asks) that might impact pricing or lead time?

Thanks — Tessa

Tessa — quick proposal from pricing:

Pilot-specific structure (option A - predictable):
- Up-front credits: $90k applied during pilot (covers first ~112k generations tokens at baseline).
- Minimum pilot commit: $20k (applied toward credits).
- Transitional per-token rates after credits: $0.00075 gen / $0.00038 embed.
- Burst token bucket: allow one-time burst pool of 3M tokens at a negotiated capped rate of $0.00065 per generation token (to handle heavier inference days). This pool resets on day 31.

Conversion incentive (if commit to $150k over 3 months):
- Apply 18% volume discount to baseline rates for the duration of the 3-month commit.
- Add $25k launch credit (apply after the pilot credits are burned).
- Include one month of extended retention on observability (30 days -> 90 days) as an entitlement.

Notes:
- Option B (lean) reduces upfront credits to $60k and increases the staggered commit to $200k with a 22% discount — we can present both to Origami.
- Compliance: Karthik, if they request VPC/private deployment during pilot, lead time is 6 weeks and we should not promise additional credits until infra is validated.

Happy to be on the call to walk procurement through the math.

—Marcus
Head of Pricing | Redwood Inference

Hi Priya / Daniel —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Based on your expected profile and Marcus' options above, we recommend Option A as the cleanest path to procurement sign-off and a fast kickoff. Attached is a short terms page plus the credit schedule that spells out baseline rates, burst pool mechanics, and the conditional launch credit tied to a $150k 3-month commit.

TL;DR (Option A):
- $90k upfront credits applied to pilot (30–45 days) + $20k minimum pilot commit.
- Post-credit rates during pilot: $0.00075 generation / $0.00038 embedding.
- One-time 3M token burst pool at $0.00065 / gen (resets at day 31).
- Conversion: if Origami signs a 3-month committed plan for $150k, Redwood will apply an 18% volume discount to baseline rates and add a $25k launch credit.

Next steps:
1) If you agree, sign the attached term sheet and return. We’ll issue credits and provision the pilot route.
2) Procurement: once we have signed SOW, we’ll open a HubSpot deal and circulate a DocuSign link for countersign.
3) Kickoff: propose Nov 29 start date if SOW is in place by Nov 24.

Link to DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/initiator/ABC123-origami-terms
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ORIGAMI-8421

Best,
